up: List all approved drugs indicated for depressive disorder. For each drug, include the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, EFO ID, EFO term (indication label), and the maximum phase for that specific indication. Use the drug_indication table to find indications for 'depressive disorder', joining to molecule_dictionary for drug details and compound_structures for SMILES. Include drugs where max_phase_for_ind is 4 or any phase indicating approval status.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  di.efo_id,
  di.efo_term AS indication_label,
  di.max_phase_for_ind
FROM drug_indication di
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON di.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE di.mesh_heading LIKE '%depressive disorder%'
